testcase.name: REV-STRUCT-01 [3.2, 12.1, NFR-02, NFR-03] single-file offline constraints are observable

REV-STRUCT-03 [BR-05, 12.2, 12.3] diary ID generator is deterministic without crypto.randomUUID
REV-FR01-01 [FR-01, 13.1] user controls follow Idle → Running → Paused → Idle and absolute time advances
REV-FR01-02 [FR-01, BR-03, 13.1] reset does not consume an already completed Focus slot
REV-FR01-03 [FR-01, BR-04, 13.1] timer controls are hidden during Memo-Input-Pending
REV-FR02-01 [FR-02, EC-01, 13.1] granted notification permission triggers sound and browser notification together
REV-FR02-02 [FR-02, EC-01, 13.1] unsupported notification and failed audio use the title fallback
REV-FR03-01 [FR-03, FR-05, BR-01, 13.1] Focus completion records before memo resolution and starts Short Break after submission
REV-FR03-02 [FR-03, BR-01, 13.1] Break expiry starts Focus without showing memo UI
REV-FR03-03 [FR-03, BR-01, 13.1] consuming the fourth Focus slot selects Long Break
REV-FR04-01 [FR-04, BR-01, 13.1] skipping Focus advances the slot without changing completion count or requesting memo
REV-FR04-02 [FR-04, BR-01, 13.1] two skipped Focus slots plus two timed completions reach Long Break with count two
REV-FR05-01 [FR-05, 13.1] blank submission is accepted and displayed as no memo
REV-FR06-01 [FR-06, 13.1] selected day shows the saved count and chronological memo order
REV-FR07-01 [FR-07, 13.1] invalid duration inputs are rejected and Idle settings update immediately
REV-FR07-02 [FR-07, 13.1] Running and Paused sessions retain their current timing while settings change
REV-FR08-01 [FR-08, EC-03, 13.1] Running state restores with its absolute end time after reload
REV-FR08-02 [FR-08, EC-03, 13.1] Paused state restores the same positive snapshot after offline time
REV-FR09-01 [FR-09, BR-05, 13.1] diary view provides two-pane layout, new button, and empty state
REV-FR09-02 [FR-09, BR-05, 13.1] diary list displays all entries sorted descending by date then creation time
REV-FR09-03 [FR-09, 13.1] selecting an entry opens its body in the editor
REV-FR09-04 [FR-09, BR-05, 13.1] invalid or corrupted diary records in localStorage are excluded without crashing
REV-FR10-01 [FR-10, 13.1] '새 일기' clears editor and enters empty new draft state

REV-FR11-02 [FR-11, 13.1] editing diary updates list preview without increasing entry count
REV-FR12-01 [FR-12, NFR-04, 13.1] typing debounces draft to storage and reload restores draft with unsaved badge
REV-FR12-02 [FR-12, 13.1] editing existing diary saves draft and reload restores edit target and body
REV-FR12-03 [FR-12, 13.1] successful save clears draft so subsequent reload shows saved state
REV-FR12-04 [FR-12, 13.1] switching editor target clears the previous draft
REV-FR12-05 [FR-12, 13.1] missing target entry for draft on reload falls back to new diary mode preserving body
REV-FR13-01 [FR-13, 13.1] Memo-Input-Pending state displays visual badge on Timer nav across all views
REV-FR13-02 [FR-13, 13.1] resolving memo clears the timer nav badge
REV-FR13-03 [FR-13, 13.1] break session expiry does not show timer nav badge
REV-EC01-01 [EC-01, FR-02] Notification denied or missing AudioContext uses document title fallback
REV-EC02-01 [EC-02, BR-06] hidden tab defers expiry until visibilitychange and reconciles target time without corrupting diary editor
REV-EC03-01 [EC-03, BR-02] multi-session offline expiry completes only once and leaves next session Idle
REV-EC03-02 [EC-03, FR-08] offline expired session log is attributed to original endTimestamp date

REV-EC05-01 [EC-05, 6.2] storage write failure keeps timer and diary usable in memory with warning banner
REV-EC05-02 [EC-05] subsequent successful write clears warning banner and syncs data

REV-13.3-U4 [13.3 User Acceptance 4] arbitrary system clock shift pauses timer and requests user confirmation without time jump
REV-13.3-U5 [13.3 User Acceptance 5] storage quota error notifies user via banner while app remains fully operational
REV-13.3-U6 [13.3 User Acceptance 6] multi-day multi-entry diary workflow allows browsing and viewing in descending order
